text.p: German insurer Allianz AG Holding said on Friday it would switch its shares to a par value of five marks effective April 28, in line with a decision taken at its shareholder meeting of October 1996.
The company also decided at that meeting to change its name from Allianz AG Holding to Allianz AG, it said in an announcement published in the German press.
Allianz has long been expected to switch to a five mark share par value from its current 50-mark shares, in line with a trend among German companies.
The move, equivalent to a 10-for-one share split, is generally expected to boost liquidity in a stock, as it reduces the price of the share to around one tenth of its former value.
The switch would cut the price of Allianz shares, the most expensive on the blue chip DAX with a price per share of around 3,170 marks on Thursday, to around 317 marks based on current prices.
